page_title: LEE 3-0 WOL | Leeds v Wolves 18/04/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+13' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+12' James Justin (Leeds) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Farai Hallam had an easy-decision to make.
90+9' Leeds are showing great team chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly.
90+6' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Lukas Nmecha (Leeds) replaces Dominic Calvert-Lewin.
90+6' Here is a change. Gabriel Gudmundsson is going off and Daniel Farke gives the last tactical orders to Joe Rodon (Leeds).
90+6' It's time for a substitution. Sean Longstaff (Leeds) comes on in place of Ao Tanaka.
90+5' 3 - 0 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Leeds) into the left of the net, giving goalkeeper Daniel Bentley no chance!
90+4' Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Leeds) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
90+3' Farai Hallam shows a yellow card to Hugo Bueno (Wolves) for his blatant foul.
90+3' Hugo Bueno (Wolves) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Farai Hallam blows his whistle for a foul. Penalty! A huge opportunity to score for Leeds.
90' 10 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' The attendance is 36840.
87' Mateus Mane (Wolves) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Farai Hallam who sees an offensive foul.
86' Ooh that was close! Pascal Struijk (Leeds) collects a pass and runs with pace goalwards before unleashing a great drive from the edge of the box, but it goes inches wide of the right post.

86' Ao Tanaka (Leeds) sends the ball into the penalty area from a free kick a few yards outside the box. The cross is good, but the goalkeeper shows himself in a good light as he leaps high to intercept the ball.
83' A goal, which was scored by Adam Armstrong (Wolves), was disallowed due to offside.
80' 14:7 – the total goal attempt statistics.
78' Daniel Farke has decided to make a change. Ilia Gruev (Leeds) replaces Brenden Aaronson.
77' Leeds have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
75' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Hee-Chan Hwang (Wolves) will replace Ladislav Krejci.
73' Brenden Aaronson (Leeds) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
70' Rodrigo Gomes (Wolves) lacks options so goes solo. It's a fine run and good shot from inside the box, but it's a whisker past the left post.

68' Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Leeds) shows good awareness deep inside the box as he latches on to a cross from the resulting free kick. He jumps high but his towering header lacks accuracy and flies yards wide of the left-hand post.
67' Rob Edwards has decided to substitute Jean-Ricner Bellegarde and he is replaced by Rodrigo Gomes (Wolves).
67' Substitution. Noah Okafor makes way for Wilfried Gnonto (Leeds).
63' A cross from a corner kick by Wolves is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
63' Ladislav Krejci (Wolves) rises highest from the corner to head at goal, but his effort towards the middle of the goal is comfortably saved by the goalkeeper.
62' Wolves have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
61' Leeds fail to score from a corner as Daniel Bentley (Wolves) leaps to collect the ball.
59' Jean-Ricner Bellegarde (Wolves) commits a foul after unfairly battling his opponent for the ball.
56' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Ao Tanaka (Leeds). Farai Hallam saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul.
51' Mateus Mane (Wolves) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
51' The Wolves players are exchanging short passes in an attempt to create a shooting opportunity.
46' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Pedro Lima (Wolves) comes onto the pitch for Jackson Tchatchoua.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+1' Ao Tanaka (Leeds) gets on the end of a good pass and from mid-range he unleashes a decent strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
43' Leeds hold possession of the ball and display neat passing from player to player. They are waiting for the right moment to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
40' Mateus Mane (Wolves) clearly handles the ball, but he is surprised when the referee blows his whistle.
39' The resulting set piece from Wolves is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
39' Mateus Mane (Wolves) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger. The ball goes out of play. Wolves are awarded a corner kick.
38' Problems for Rob Edwards as Angel Gomes is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Mateus Mane (Wolves) replaces him.
37' Jean-Ricner Bellegarde (Wolves) fizzes over a cross which doesn't cause any problems.

32' Ao Tanaka (Leeds) takes the resulting free kick from outside the box. He sends a nice cross into the box, but his intention is well anticipated by the goalkeeper who comes out to collect the ball.
31' Ladislav Krejci (Wolves) trips an opposition player and Farai Hallam signals a foul. A free kick has been awarded to Leeds.
31' Leeds keep the ball and are displaying some tiki-taka style passing at the moment.
29' Karl Darlow displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Angel Gomes (Wolves) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.

26' Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Leeds) brilliantly evades multiple challenges and bends in a shot from the edge of the box low towards the middle of the goal. It's a weak effort, however, and is easily saved by Daniel Bentley.
25' Adam Armstrong (Wolves) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
25' Wolves will have a chance to score from a corner kick.

25' Adam Armstrong (Wolves) bursts into the box and latches on to a pin-point long through ball, but one of the defenders steps in to clear the ball to safety. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Wolves will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
23' The ball possession is 49:51.
23' Some neat passing and movement from Wolves as they ping around some short passes in order to create a new attacking opportunity.
20' 2 - 0 Goal - 2:0! Brenden Aaronson laid the ball off to Noah Okafor (Leeds), who slots it into the back of the net from close range, leaving the goalkeeper helpless.
18' 1 - 0 GOAL! James Justin (Leeds) gets to the rebound inside the box and fires in a stunning overhead kick. Phenomenal finish! 1:0.
18' The ball goes out of play. Leeds are awarded a corner kick.
16' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Ladislav Krejci (Wolves).
15' Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Leeds) gets to the ball from the resulting corner and tries his luck with a shot, but one of the defenders steps in to block the effort.
14' The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Leeds.
13' James Justin (Leeds) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away. The linesman points to the corner flag, Leeds are going to take it.
10' The corner is swung in but Leeds can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
9' Noah Okafor (Leeds) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat. It will be a corner kick for Leeds.
8' Leeds string together a series of short passes.
4' Wolves failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
3' Wolves quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
1' Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Leeds) came close to scoring. He connected with a pass inside the box and perhaps should have done better than direct his shot straight at Daniel Bentley.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
